segments.ja525:1.3: Sirasmiṃ palitaṃ jātaṃ, pabbajjaṃ dāni rocahaṃ”.
segments.ja525:2.1: “Abhumme kathaṃ nu bhaṇasi, sallaṃ me deva urasi kappesi [kampesi (pī.)];
segments.ja525:2.3: Sattasatā te bhariyā, kathaṃ nu te tā bhavissanti”.
segments.ja525:4.1: “Dulladdhaṃ me āsi sutasoma, yassa te homahaṃ mātā;
segments.ja525:4.3: Yaṃ me vilapantiyā, anapekkho pabbajasi deva.
segments.ja525:5.1: “Dulladdhaṃ me āsi sutasoma, yaṃ taṃ ahaṃ vijāyissaṃ;
segments.ja525:5.3: Yaṃ me vilapantiyā, anapekkho pabbajasi deva”.
segments.ja525:6.1: “Ko nāmeso dhammo, sutasoma kā ca nāma pabbajjā;
segments.ja525:6.3: Yaṃ no amhe jiṇṇe, anapekkho pabbajasi deva.
segments.ja525:7.3: Mañjū tepi [te (sī. pī.)] taṃ apassantā, maññe dukkhaṃ nigacchanti”.
segments.ja525:8.3: Mañjūhi sabbehipi tumhehi, cirampi ṭhatvā vināsabhāvo”[vinābhāvo (sī. syā. pī.)].
segments.ja525:9.1: “Chinnaṃ nu tuyhaṃ hadayaṃ, adu te [ādu (sī. pī.), ādū (syā.)] karuṇā ca natthi amhesu;
segments.ja525:9.3: Yaṃ no vikandantiyo [vikkandantiyo (sī.)], anapekkho pabbajasi deva”.
segments.ja525:10.1: “Na ca mayhaṃ chinnaṃ hadayaṃ, atthi karuṇāpi mayhaṃ tumhesu;
segments.ja525:10.3: Saggañca patthayāno, tena ahaṃ [tenāhaṃ (sī. syā.), tenamahaṃ (pī.)] pabbajissāmi”.
segments.ja525:11.1: “Dulladdhaṃ me āsi, sutasoma yassa te ahaṃ bhariyā;
segments.ja525:11.3: Yaṃ me vilapantiyā, anapekkho pabbajasi deva.
segments.ja525:12.1: “Dulladdhaṃ me āsi, sutasoma yassa te ahaṃ bhariyā;
segments.ja525:12.3: Yaṃ me kucchipaṭisandhiṃ [maṃ kucchimatiṃ santiṃ (pī.)], anapekkho pabbajasi deva.
segments.ja525:13.1: “Paripakko me gabbho, kucchigato yāva naṃ vijāyāmi;
segments.ja525:13.3: Māhaṃ ekā vidhavā, pacchā dukkhāni addakkhiṃ”.
segments.ja525:14.1: “Paripakko te gabbho, kucchigato iṅgha tvaṃ [tva (sī.), naṃ (pī.)] vijāyassu;
segments.ja525:15.1: “Mā tvaṃ cande rudi, mā soci vanatimiramattakkhi;
segments.ja525:15.3: Āroha varapāsādaṃ [ca pāsādaṃ (pī.)], anapekkho ahaṃ gamissāmi”.
segments.ja525:16.1: “Ko taṃ amma kopesi, kiṃ rodasi pekkhasi ca maṃ bāḷhaṃ;
segments.ja525:16.3: Kaṃ avajjhaṃ ghātemi [ghātemi kaṃ avajjhaṃ (pī.), taṃ avajjhaṃ ghātemi (ka.)], ñātīnaṃ udikkhamānānaṃ”.
segments.ja525:17.1: “Na hi so sakkā hantuṃ, vijitāvī [jīvitāvī (pī.)] yo maṃ tāta kopesi;
segments.ja525:17.3: Pitā te maṃ tāta avaca, anapekkho ahaṃ gamissāmi”.
segments.ja525:18.1: “Yohaṃ pubbe niyyāmi, uyyānaṃ mattakuñjare ca yodhemi;
segments.ja525:18.3: Sutasome pabbajite, kathaṃ nu dāni karissāmi”.
segments.ja525:19.1: “Mātucca [mātu ca (sī. syā.)] me rudantyā [rudatyā (pī.)], jeṭṭhassa ca bhātuno akāmassa;
segments.ja525:19.3: Hatthepi te gahessaṃ, na hi gacchasi [gañchisi (pī.)] no akāmānaṃ”.
segments.ja525:20.1: “Uṭṭhehi tvaṃ dhāti, imaṃ kumāraṃ ramehi aññattha;
segments.ja525:20.3: Mā me paripanthamakāsi [makā (sī. pī.)], saggaṃ mama patthayānassa”.
segments.ja525:21.1: “Yaṃ nūnimaṃ dadeyyaṃ [jaheyyaṃ (pī.)] pabhaṅkaraṃ, ko nu me imināttho [ko nu me iminā attho (sī. syā.), ko nu me nattho (pī.)];
segments.ja525:21.3: Sutasome pabbajite, kiṃ nu menaṃ karissāmi”.
segments.ja525:22.1: “Koso ca tuyhaṃ vipulo, koṭṭhāgārañca tuyhaṃ paripūraṃ;
segments.ja525:22.3: Pathavī ca tuyhaṃ vijitā, ramassu mā pabbaji [pabbajassu (sī.), pabbaja (pī.)] deva”.
segments.ja525:23.1: “Koso ca mayhaṃ vipulo, koṭṭhāgārañca mayhaṃ paripūraṃ;
segments.ja525:23.3: Pathavī ca mayhaṃ vijitā, taṃ hitvā pabbajissāmi”.
segments.ja525:24.1: “Mayhampi dhanaṃ pahūtaṃ, saṅkhātuṃ [saṅkhyātuṃ (sī.)] nopi deva sakkomi;
segments.ja525:24.3: Taṃ te dadāmi sabbampi [taṃ deva te dadāmi sabbampi (sī.), taṃ te dadāmi sabbaṃ (pī.)], ramassu mā pabbaji deva”.
segments.ja525:25.1: “Jānāmi [jānāmi te (sī. syā.)] dhanaṃ pahūtaṃ, kulavaddhana pūjito tayā casmi;
segments.ja525:26.3: Bahukāpi [bahukā hi (sī. syā.)] me antarāyā, ajjevāhaṃ pabbajissāmi”.
segments.ja525:27.1: “Idañca tuyhaṃ rucitaṃ, sutasoma ajjeva dāni tvaṃ pabbaja;
segments.ja525:27.3: Ahampi pabbajissāmi, na ussahe tayā vinā ahaṃ ṭhātuṃ”.
segments.ja525:28.1: “Na hi sakkā pabbajituṃ, nagare na hi paccati janapade ca”;
segments.ja525:29.3: Evaṃ suparittake jīvite, na ca pamajjituṃ kālo.
segments.ja525:30.3: Evaṃ suparittake jīvite, andhabālā [atha bālā (sī. syā. pī.)] pamajjanti.
segments.ja525:32.1: “Ūhaññate rajaggaṃ, avidūre pubbakamhi ca [pupphakamhi ca (sī. pī.)] pāsāde;
segments.ja525:32.3: Maññe no kesā chinnā, yasassino dhammarājassa”.
segments.ja525:49.1: “Rājā vo kho [rājā kho (sī. syā. pī.)] pabbajito, sutasomo rajjaṃ imaṃ pahatvāna [pahantvāna (syā. ka.)];
segments.ja525:50.3: Mā vo kāmā haniṃsu, rammaṃ hi [surammañhi (syā. ka.)] sudassanaṃ [sudassanaṃ nāma (sī.)] nagaraṃ.
segments.ja525:51.1: “Mettacittañca [mettañca (pī.)] bhāvetha, appamāṇaṃ divā ca ratto ca;
segments.ja525:51.3: Agacchittha [atha gañchittha (sī. syā. pī.)] devapura, āvāsaṃ puññakamminan”ti [puññakammānanti (pī.)].
